headline: Whoop launches Whoop Humans, a social network for sharing fitness data
summary: Whoop launched Whoop Humans, a social network letting members share sleep, recovery and workout data, post photo-based "Moments," and react to other users' posts. One outlet says the bigger strategic goal is turning Whoop into a broader personal health brand, with CEO Will Ahmed hinting at future acquisitions.
